raw_response:
I will keep my main land in the wheat-maize rotation, because that is what I know best and it fits my well irrigation. I am 70, so I will not make the plan too complicated or too labor-heavy. I will put most of my land into winter wheat followed by summer maize, and keep a smaller piece in cotton. For wheat, I will use improved seed, put enough nitrogen to hold yield, and irrigate at the key times because I have a well and I do not want to gamble on rainfall. After wheat harvest, I will plant hybrid maize on the same land and use no-tillage to save labor and time. For cotton, I will keep only a small area because it needs more pest watching and more hand work, but I still want some because I already grow it and it helps spread risk. I will stay with moderate fertilizer rates, not the highest, because I want stable output and manageable cost.
